topic: The My Little Pony trading card trend (Kayou x Hasbro), November 2026

Age of The Nerd: Hasbro and KAYOU bring My Little Pony cards to New York Comic Con
Trading Card Archives: My Little Pony – Kayou's Trading Card Rocket Ship
Etsy: My Little Pony Kayou cards listings

context:
- Kayou is a trading card maker that publishes official, licensed My Little Pony cards with Hasbro. (SOURCE: https://www.comicsbeat.com/nycc-26-hasbro-and-kayou-my-little-pony-tcg-set-exclusives-experiences/)
- The latest set, 'My Little Pony Friendship Eternal Cards – Moon Edition 4', has 162 unique cards across 10 rarity tiers. (SOURCE: https://www.comicsbeat.com/nycc-26-hasbro-and-kayou-my-little-pony-tcg-set-exclusives-experiences/)
- The cards are slated for Target, Walmart, Best Buy, GameStop, Barnes & Noble, Amazon, TikTok Shop and local hobby stores across the U.S. (SOURCE: https://www.comicsbeat.com/nycc-26-hasbro-and-kayou-my-little-pony-tcg-set-exclusives-experiences/)
- At New York Comic Con 2026, Kayou sold the first oversized KAYOU card ever offered for purchase, an exclusive co-created with BOOM! Studios. Kayou has three new My Little Pony card releases planned for U.S. fans. (SOURCE: https://ageofthenerd.com/2026/10/hasbro-and-kayou-bring-my-little-pony-cards-nycc-exclusives-fan-fueled-fun-to-new-york-comic-con/)
- One collector blog reports that some boxes that used to cost about $30 are now listed for $3,000 or more (anecdotal, single source - attribute it as 'one collector blog' and say 'listed', not 'sold'). It says the cards sparked a whole new fanbase. Bootleg boxes exist that lack the Kayou logo and are lower quality. (SOURCE: https://tradingcardarchives.com/2024/08/09/my-little-pony-kayous-trading-card-rocket-ship/)
- On Etsy, individual rare 2026 My Little Pony Kayou cards are listed for roughly $9 up to $269 (asking prices, not confirmed sales). (SOURCE: https://www.etsy.com/market/my_little_pony_kayou_cards)
- Kayou runs an official U.S. TikTok Shop store selling the cards. (SOURCE: https://shop.tiktok.com/us/store/kayou-us/7494109179661485529)
- Do NOT claim it is the biggest trend, do NOT invent sales numbers or demographics. Do NOT name or describe specific My Little Pony characters.
